request.prompt: Create exactly ONE faithful complete 2D game-asset sprite of the standard Remnant Breacher drone from Mass Effect Andromeda, using the supplied BioWare finished textured three-view model sheet as the visual authority. Output only the LOWER CENTER view, the hovering front three-quarter angle. Precisely reproduce the broad low angular charcoal and steel-grey shell, two horizontally extended side pods with thin blue-white light strips along the leading edges, faceted central body and pale central optical light, exposed fine mechanical elements below it, two long jointed angular pincer arms curving downward and inward, and the narrow upper rear fin visible behind the shell. Keep the proportions and arrangement of this lower-center reference intact: both lateral pods, both complete pincer tips and the rear fin fully visible. The other two views are only supporting geometry references, not additional output subjects. Preserve panel seams, layered plates, wear, dark metallic materials and restrained pale luminous lines. No humanoid limbs, feet, thrusters, added weapons, firing laser, changed chassis or invented ornaments. Render a detailed realistic neutral-lit crisp game-asset cutout in the exact same single hovering pose. The drone must occupy at most 82 percent of the canvas width and height, with ample transparent margin beyond the wing pods, fin and pincer tips. Fully transparent background, no black backdrop, scenery, platform, floor, cast shadow, reflection, halo, beam, text, labels, logos, border, duplicate drone or model sheet.

notes: Three complete finished textured Breacher views inspected by root; lower-center view selected.
Name cross-check recorded separately against a labeled gameplay capture; model sheet governs geometry and palette.
Single hover pose only; relative game scale, movement and effects remain unvalidated.
